lines.text: Лежачи на животі. Ляжте на живіт, витягніть стегна і залиштеся так. 10 хвилин, 2 рази на день.
lines.source_en: Lying face down. Lie on your stomach with both hips straight and stay there. 10 minutes, 2 times a day.
lines.back_translation: Lying on the stomach. Lie on your stomach, extend the hips and remain like that. 10 minutes, 2 times a day.

lines.text: Місток на одній нозі (ліва). Ляжте на спину, зігніть ліву ногу, інша пряма, підніміть стегна від ліжка. 3 × 10, щодня.
lines.source_en: Single-leg bridge (left). Lie on your back with your left knee bent and the other leg straight, and lift your hips off the bed. 3 × 10, every day.
lines.back_translation: Bridge on one leg (left). Lie on your back, bend your left leg, the other leg is straight, lift the hips from the bed. 3 × 10, every day.

lines.text: Підйом ноги на боці (ліва). Ляжте на бік, підніміть верхню ногу прямо вгору, потім повільно опустіть. 3 × 12, щодня.
lines.source_en: Side-lying leg lift (left). Lie on your side and lift the upper leg straight up, then lower it slowly. 3 × 12, every day.
lines.back_translation: Leg lift on the side (left). Lie on your side, lift the upper leg straight up, then slowly lower it. 3 × 12, every day.

lines.text: Випрямлення коліна сидячи з еспандером (ліва). Сядьте на стілець, еспандер на гомілці, повільно випрямте коліно. 3 × 12, щодня.
lines.source_en: Seated knee straightening with a band (left). Sit on a chair with the band around the ankle and straighten the knee slowly. 3 × 12, every day.
lines.back_translation: Knee straightening while sitting with an expander (left). Sit on a chair, the expander is on the shin, slowly straighten the knee. 3 × 12, every day.

lines.text: Стійка на одній нозі (ліва). Стойте на одній нозі біля стійки, за яку можна вчепитися, і тримайте положення. 3 × 30 секунд, щодня, вдома. Стойте біля кухонної стійки. З ваших записів: Перевіряйте шкіру кульшової частини після носіння протеза.
lines.source_en: Single-leg stance (left). Stand on one leg next to a counter you can grab, and hold the position. 3 × 30 seconds, every day, at home. Stand next to the kitchen counter. From your records: Check the skin of the residual limb after wearing the prosthesis.
lines.back_translation: Standing on one leg (left). Stand on one leg next to a counter you can grab, and hold the position. 3 × 30 seconds, every day, at home. Stand next to the kitchen counter. From your records: Check the skin of the hip part after wearing the prosthesis.

objections.detail: R04: documented restriction found, therapist decides. Standing on the left prosthesis alone only in supervised sessions until the prosthetist clears it.

raised.detail: R04: documented restriction found, therapist decides. Standing on the left prosthesis alone only in supervised sessions until the prosthetist clears it.
